card.name: Linking words inside lists and phrases
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', and small words such as 'her' or 'the' in general web text, right before the next noun or verb in a list or phrase. It is mostly seen in news and advocacy writing, not drug labels.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or 'and' between items in a series of nouns or verbs.
modes.example: Social influence takes many forms and can be seen in conformity, socialization<<,>> peer pressure, obedience, leadership, persuasion

modes.label: Small word before a noun
modes.description: A possessive or article such as 'her' or 'the' just before a noun that is about to follow.
modes.example: Attorney General Eric Holder pauses as he testifies on Capitol Hill before<< the>> House Judiciary Committee Wednesday.

card.writes: It slightly favors the word 'property' and a few other nouns, and disfavors physical-science words like viscosity and airflow, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and commas in lists in everyday web text, just before the next item.
